基于药物相互作用的肾脏疾病患者用药教育实践
黄欣，李宏建，苏乐群\*山东省千佛山医院药学部，济南 250014
Medication Education Based on Drug Interaction for Patients with Renal Diseases
HUANG Xin, LI Hong-jian, SU Le-qun $^{*}$Department of Pharmacy, Shandong Provincial Qianfoshan Hospital, Jinan 250014, China[Abstract] To discuss a method of patient education, the author instructs patients with renal diseases about drug interaction within the processes of drug absorption, distribution, metabolism and excretion in daily practice. It's feasible to carry out patient education about drug interaction. It's important for patients to learn about drug interaction to improve the therapeutic effect and decrease medication risk.对患者进行用药教育是临床药师工作职责中的一项内容，用药教育旨在帮助患者按时按量正确地服用药物，了解药物的不良反应及注意事项，从而提高患者的用药依从性，这对于保证药物疗效及用药安全至关重要。
